title: Figure 14. Effects of Breakup q-alpha on A for Atlas IIAS
description: Line chart of "Mode-5 Constant A" (2.5 to 6.5) versus "Breakup q-alpha (deg-lb/ft^2)" (0 to 25,000), with five downward-sloping lines labeled B = 1,000, 50,000, 100,000, 500,000 and 5,000,000. Text below begins section 6.2.2, "Launch-Area Mode-5 Risks," for an Atlas IIAS daytime launch of a Telstar-4 payload from Pad 36A.
